name: Author byline + bio card
description: A compact byline strip at the top of a post and a fuller author bio card to close it out.

name: Related articles
description: A "Read next" grid surfacing three more posts by category, title, and read time.

name: Reading-progress bar
description: A progress bar pinned to the top of a scroll container that fills as you read inside the box.

name: Tag / category filter
description: A chip row that live-filters the post list below by category.

name: Trending / most-popular list
description: A ranked list with oversized numerals and an optional view-count meta line.

name: Series / chapter nav
description: A "Part 2 of 5" bar with titled previous/next arrows and a thin progress indicator.

name: Pull quote
description: An oversized, offset quote block with a large quotation mark, accent rule, and attribution.
